Bovenaanzicht van de unit: klik op een v: Top view of the unit: click a section along a wall to switch between closed, window and door. Each section is 1 metre; a 1.80 m window takes up two sections: the one you clicked and the free section to its right (or to its left if the right one is taken). If you then click the free section next to a window, a second window is placed right beside it. Two windows in the middle of a 6 m wall: click section 2 and section 4. On a 3 m wall, a click on the middle section gives one window in the middle. Click a window again for a door, and once more for closed. Coupled units stand long side to long side and form one open space, with unit 1 at the front. With two storeys you set up the upper floor separately.
